crossRefs.note: All my affairs will be made known to you by Tychicus, the beloved brother, faithful servant, and fellow bondservant in…
I beg you for my child, whom I have become the father of in my chains, Onesimus,

translations.web: together with Onesimus, the faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They will make known to you everything that is going on here.
translations.bsb: With him I am sending Onesimus, our faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They will tell you about everything here.
translations.kjv: With Onesimus, a faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They shall make known unto you all things which are done here.
translations.asv: together with Onesimus, the faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They shall make known unto you all things that are done here.
